meta.name: generic-language-killer
meta.description: Remove vague, corporate, or AI-sounding language and replace it with clear, specific, human wording. Trigger on "improve copy", "sounds generic", "too fluffy".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把模糊、套话、AI腔改成清晰具体的人话
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常写文案但总被说太虚、太像AI写的。
copy.tagline_en: Replace vague, corporate, or AI-sounding language with clear, specific wording
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often write copy but get feedback that it sounds generic or AI-generated.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会识别并删除模糊、空洞或像AI写的词句，替换成清晰、具体、像人说的话。
howto.when: 当你要求“改进文案”、“听起来太笼统”或“太虚”时触发。

say.text: 帮我改进这段文案，它听起来太笼统了。
say.note: Claude 会删除模糊词，给出更具体的版本。

say.text: 这段文字太虚了，请去掉空洞的套话。
say.note: Claude 会替换掉空洞的套话，让语言更直接。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will identify and remove vague, empty, or AI-sounding language, replacing it with clear, specific, human wording.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "improve copy", say it "sounds generic", or "too fluffy".

say_en.text: Improve this copy, it sounds too generic.
say_en.note: Claude will remove vague phrases and give a more specific version.

say_en.text: This text is too fluffy, remove the empty buzzwords.
say_en.note: Claude will replace fluff with direct statements.
